verses.text: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
lines: Bless Yahweh, my soul.
Yahweh, my God, you are very great.
You are clothed with honor and majesty.

verses.text: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
lines: He covers himself with light as with a garment.
He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

verses.text: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
lines: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters.
He makes the clouds his chariot.
He walks on the wings of the wind.

verses.text: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
lines: He makes his messengers winds,
and his servants flames of fire.

verses.text: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
lines: He laid the foundations of the earth,
that it should not be moved forever.

verses.text: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
lines: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak.
The waters stood above the mountains.

verses.text: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
lines: At your rebuke they fled.
At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

verses.text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
lines: The mountains rose,
the valleys sank down,
to the place which you had assigned to them.

verses.text: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
lines: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over,
that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

verses.text: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
lines: He sends springs into the valleys.
They run among the mountains.

verses.text: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
lines: They give drink to every animal of the field.
The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

verses.text: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
lines: The birds of the sky nest by them.
They sing among the branches.

verses.text: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
lines: He waters the mountains from his rooms.
The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

verses.text: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
lines: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock,
and plants for man to cultivate,
that he may produce food out of the earth:

verses.text: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
lines: wine that makes the heart of man glad,
oil to make his face to shine,
and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

verses.text: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
lines: Yahweh’s trees are well watered,
the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;

verses.text: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
lines: where the birds make their nests.
The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

verses.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
lines: The high mountains are for the wild goats.
The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

verses.text: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
lines: He appointed the moon for seasons.
The sun knows when to set.

verses.text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
lines: You make darkness, and it is night,
in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

verses.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
lines: The young lions roar after their prey,
and seek their food from God.

verses.text: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
lines: The sun rises, and they steal away,
and lie down in their dens.

verses.text: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
lines: Man goes out to his work,
to his labor until the evening.

verses.text: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
lines: Yahweh, how many are your works!
In wisdom, you have made them all.
The earth is full of your riches.

verses.text: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
lines: There is the sea, great and wide,
in which are innumerable living things,
both small and large animals.

verses.text: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
lines: There the ships go,
and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

verses.text: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
lines: These all wait for you,
that you may give them their food in due season.

verses.text: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
lines: You give to them; they gather.
You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

verses.text: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
lines: You hide your face; they are troubled.
You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

verses.text: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
lines: You send out your Spirit and they are created.
You renew the face of the ground.

verses.text: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
lines: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever.
Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

verses.text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
lines: He looks at the earth, and it trembles.
He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.text: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
lines: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live.
I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

verses.text: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
lines: Let my meditation be sweet to him.
I will rejoice in Yahweh.

verses.text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
lines: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth.
Let the wicked be no more.
Bless Yahweh, my soul.
Praise Yah!
